snippet.title: Stay With Me Official Trailer
snippet.description:
🕯️ STAY WITH ME — Cinematic Trailer

Some houses hide memories.

Some memories should never be remembered.

Stay With Me is a psychological horror game where you step into an isolated house to care for an elderly woman suffering from dementia. What begins as a simple favor slowly turns into a terrifying journey through grief, forgotten memories, and secrets that were never meant to be uncovered.

🏚️ Explore a house filled with secrets
🧩 Solve disturbing puzzles
👻 Face psychological horror and unsettling encounters
📖 Uncover a story where nothing is quite what it seems

But be careful...

The house remembers.

🎮 PLAY THE FREE DEMO NOW

👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/5053620/Stay_with_me_Demo/?beta=0

❤️ Wishlist Stay With Me on Steam and uncover the truth when the full game releases.
